facts.fact: Mauritania's Ministry of Digital Transformation, Innovation and Modernisation of Administration issued the National AI Strategy 2025-2029 in a final Arabic edition with thirteen axes; the document gives no adoption date, so as_of is its published month (2024-07).

note: Its governance chapter says a sub-committee of the Supreme Council for Digitalisation will be established to monitor the strategy: a future body, not yet named as set up.
